课程简介（中文）

本课程关注（营利性或非营利性）商业组织的根本目标：“生存、活得更好、活得更久”。课程涉及对过去及当前战略的识别与分析、新战略的制定，并通过组织在全球经济环境中的演进与运营来实施这些战略。课程聚焦于业务单元战略、公司战略（包括业务演进路径与节奏的选择），以及合作竞争互动战略，以解决“如何”通过“谁”来完成“什么”的问题，并探讨企业凭借什么得以建立、生存与消亡。

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

课程简介（英文）

This course is concerned with the fundamental objective, "to live, to live well, and to live longer," of the (for profit or not-for-profit) business organization. It deals with identifying and analyzing past and current strategies, with formulating new ones and with implementing them through the organization evolving and operating in the global economic environment. It focuses on business unit strategy, corporate strategy (including choice of business evolution path and pace), co-opetition interactive strategy to solve the problems about "how" to get "what" done through "whom" and by what the firms can set-up, survive and die.

教学目标

This course is concerned with building of the guarantee system about firm’s long-term survival. It aims at training the students’capabilities to grasp the overall nature of business, to analyse environment, mission, and competence of a firm, to caft and to execute strategy of uniqueness, trade-offs, and synergy. The ways of thinking, analytical skills and practice of art, discussed in this course. can be widely applicable to all types of for-profit and not-for-profit organizations. As a result of this course, students will be able to: 1) enhance ability to think the corporate strategy as a whole 2) learn the framework of strategic thinking 3) understand the essence of successful strategy crafting, implementing and executing  in practice

教学方式

Lecturing, case analysis, group presentation
